description: 4 should-trigger + 4 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers resolving conflict markers, conflicts during a rebase, choosing a side safely, and a German phrasing. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbours (bringing a branch up to date without a conflict, squashing pushed history, merging a PR into main) plus one unrelated counterexample.

queries.q: resolve the merge conflict in src/exporter.ts
my rebase stopped with conflicts, how do I continue?
which side do I keep in this <<<<<<< HEAD block?
ich habe einen Konflikt beim Rebase, wie löse ich den?
update my feature branch with the latest main
queries.note: choosing merge vs rebase for an update is git-workflow's branch-update reference; no conflict exists yet

queries.q: squash the last two pushed commits
queries.note: history rewriting is git-history-discipline, not conflict resolution
